name: abstractwiki_integrations
comment: Integrations of Abstract Wikipedia articles into client wikis. One row per period in which a client wiki shows an abstract article at a local title; rows are closed, never deleted. Lives on the shared x1 cluster via the 'virtual-abstractwiki' virtual domain.

columns.name: awi_title
columns.comment: The primary local title, in the client wiki's main namespace, in DB key form

columns.name: awi_qid
columns.comment: The Wikidata item ID of the abstract article (e.g. 'Q90')

columns.name: awi_removed
columns.comment: When the integration ended; null while it is live

columns.name: awi_removed_reason
columns.comment: Why the integration ended: 1 for opted out, 2 for replaced by a local article; null while it is live

indexes.name: awi_wiki_title_removed
indexes.comment: Find the live integrations of a client wiki, or of one of its titles

indexes.name: awi_qid
indexes.comment: Find the client wikis that integrate an abstract article
